'''Lightning Squadron''' was an elite cavalry unit that was part of the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Reconnaissance Corps]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

==History==
{{Quote|Lightning Squadron! Reckless, snobbish glory-hounds and special-forces wannabes. Yeah, they rejected my application. But I didn't want to join them, anyway.|Sergeant [[Frumm]], hero of the [[Battle of Vulcusion]]|<ref name="GAW" />}}
The unit was established at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to handle special recon missions. Lightning Squadron consisted of ten [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF Troopers]] specially trained to operate [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]] and could be divided into two five-man squads, or lances, each led by a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. A [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] was the commanding officer of the entire unit. Despite being subordinate to higher officials, the unit maintained a certain amount of autonomy and often worked behind enemy lines, far from any immediate help.<ref name="GAW" />

===Clone Wars===
During its first action, the [[Battle of Herdessa (Clone Wars)|Battle of Herdessa]], six days after [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the unit disabled the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|central control computer]] on board a [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] after crossing the battle lines. This temporarily shut down the droid forces, which allowed the [[121st Regiment]] free passage past [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] artillery.<ref name="GAW" />

During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], the squadron led three other AT-RT recon units in harassing [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer]] units and prevented an organized response to the main force's encirclement of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] stronghold.<ref name="GAW" />

At the [[Battle of Daalang]], the unit crossed through the Separatist energy shield that protected an anti-orbital [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]], rushed past its defenses, and destroyed the shield generator. This allowed the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Eliminator (Clone Wars)|''Eliminator'']] to bombard the cannon as Lightning Squadron rushed back to friendly lines.<ref name="GAW" />

[[File:LightningSquadron-LoR.png|thumb|left|250px|Lightning Squadron begins its assault on the capital of Lessu]]
Under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], it participated in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. The unit greatly helped in the liberation of the world from [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]]. Lightning Squadron was a division of Windu's force during the offensive to free Ryloth's capital.<ref name="TCWLOR" />

Windu led his force to the capital via a cliffside path. This was a risky decision that did not escape the notice of the Separatist defenders. In an attempt to neutralize the Republic forces before they became a strategic threat, the Separatists sent a tank division to box the walkers in by disabling the leading and rearmost units before destroying the entire group. As the Republic force fell under heavy fire, Mace Windu ordered the deployment of Lightning Squadron's AT-RTs. Mace Windu led Lightning Squadron in a charge that completely routed the Separatist tanks, freeing the rest of the walker division to advance to their objective. They later took part in storming the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] alongside [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla's]] freedom fighters.<ref name="TCWLOR" />

[[Razor/Legends|Razor]] and [[Stak/Legends|Stak]] were two particularly notable members during this battle. The pair served as Windu's companions for much of the campaign, accompanying him during his dealings with Syndulla's freedom fighters. Later, he took them along during his attempted infiltration of the [[Plasma bridge/Legends|plasma bridge]] control center in a Separatist convoy, which was spoiled by a Separatist inspection. The Separatist droids tried to drop Windu, Razor and Stak into the canyon below by shutting off the bridge's power, but with Windu's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers, they crossed safely. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] held off the Separatist defenders so the pair of ARFs could storm the control center and enable the liberation force to enter the city.<ref name="TCWLOR" />

Ponds was later killed by [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] aboard [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].

[[File:Atrtpatrol.jpg|thumb|right|225px|[[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] [[AT-RT driver|pilots]] of Lightning Squadron]]
Late in the war, the unit saw action during the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]] before being transferred to [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Following [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Lightning Squadron continued in Imperial service, still under the 91st Corps that was now within the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="GAW" />

===Under the Empire===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the unit retained its AT-RT walkers and was augmented with armored [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] and [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]], among other vehicles. Fighting against Rebels often meant probing their defenses and armaments by harassing Rebel bases, ahead of the main army, thus gaining vital intel for the main operation. It operated mainly under Army control, despite having clones in its ranks. As the war continued, members of the [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] division of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] were transferred to the unit, and Lightning Squadron gained a floating status where it worked under different branches depending on the current goal.<ref name="GAW" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the squadron participated in the [[Ryoone campaign]] and, over the period of a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], participated in a series of engagements against the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization [[Churhee's Riflemen]]. However, the squadron was eventually defeated.<ref name="GAW" />
